items.label: POP QUIZ
items.problem: its header says 3,584 bytes and the block holds 512
items.why: the boot program in the KERNAL format: Novaload, which points the LOAD vector at $0330 to its own routine at $033C and loads the rest of the tape with it (orientation.md, The loader)

items.label: pulses 61715-1530679
items.problem: 1,468,965 pulses in a format the kit does not decode, most of them 312 or 712 cycles long
items.why: 26 files in Novaload format, read by work/novaload.py with every checksum right (orientation.md, table of files): the second stage NOVA and the loading picture 0, which the game loads over and graphics.html draws from its bytes; the program files 3 ($4200-$CFFF), 4 ($E000-$FF4A) and 2 ($0C00-$3FFF), equal to the hand-over snapshot byte for byte, and 1, which loads at $2400 and which the second stage copies to $0400 (its loop at $4099) before file 2 loads over $0C00 onwards, all 2,048 bytes equal there; and five question blocks of four files each (FX, then three), which load into the quiz part ($4F00-$53FF and $B800-$FEFF); block 1 is the quiz listing, and the Questions page reads all five
